message:
Let me install `libclang-common-18-dev` which should contain the ASAN runtime:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'apt-get install -y -qq libclang-common-18-dev 2>&1 | tail -3 && ls /usr/lib/llvm-18/lib/clang/18/lib/linux/ 2>/dev/null | head -10' 2>&1 | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
